changes: Preserve bounded structured server error codes without exposing response message text.
Explicit CONNECTION_TERMINATED immediately clears local authority, microphone, media and pending retries, without follow-up resume, media deletion or leave requests.

Only CONNECTION_LEASE_EXPIRED and legacy CONNECTION_EXPIRED are resumable 410 confirmations. Current-operation 401 and other 410 responses terminate locally; a definitive resume 401/410 never triggers a fresh watch open.

Keep each start's remote connection identity across media recovery. Late old-operation 401 or unknown 410 failures cannot terminate a replacement operation or later start; explicit CONNECTION_TERMINATED remains authoritative only for its owning management connection.
Retain the existing media configuration, 48 kHz stereo content playback, focus isolation, on-demand statistics and independent microphone privacy policy.

verification.jvm_test_scope: Earlier 19 JVM tests are historical; no new 1000013 JVM test run is claimed.

native_termination_acceptance.scope: Source review and signed compilation do not replace actual Android stop/recovery acceptance against a deployed compatible server.

audio_acceptance.scope: The separate 1000012 audio acceptance belongs to that exact older APK and is recorded independently. No audio or physical-device result is attributed to 1000013 by this release receipt.

limits: Publication, signature and packaging checks do not prove Android audio-chain, physical-device or deployed lifecycle acceptance.
Unknown transport errors retain the existing same-connection recovery policy. No new overall retry duration or automatic fresh watch open is introduced.
Official disposable CI AVD volume calibration is acceptance-only; the production APK does not set system volume, force a speaker route or change microphone processing defaults.
Older APK input, human-speech and stability evidence retains its original version boundaries.
This Android publication does not deploy or update Windows/Linux server components.
Example, probes, raw audio, emulator tools, test credentials and signing private keys are excluded from the APK.
